svg.text: How well each constellation predicts UTC
BIPM Circular T Section 4 · 426 daily values · 2025-04-29 to 2026-06-28
Each value is published weeks after the fact: the newest point in an issue is a median 13 days old, the oldest 42.
Upper panel is clipped at −60 ns; GLONASS reaches −56.9, and is omitted below because it rarely stays in frame.
